asOf: All source/peer/normalization artifacts computedThrough at or before source close < prediction origin. Calibration availableAt after first target close < both validation origins. Temporal reliability artifact availableAt after final target closes; cannot be dispatched earlier. Final dictionary snapshots retain same-as-of across lanes.
calibration: Unchanged intercept+slope mapping; fit calibration-period pairs only>=100. availableAt strictly after calibration final close. Freeze artifact and apply only at later validation origins. Separate two validation targets, no fit on validation targets. Pair support is measured now but no mapping or validation scores fitted.
missing: No low-confidence substitution, no fabricated priors, NaN gaps retained; old registry/Gate/result unchanged.

sampleConfidence.INSUFFICIENT: No eligible finite posterior/uncertainty/peer prediction. A prior is not fabricated when no saved prior exists.
sampleConfidence.LOW: Finite eligible stored posterior, but HIGH/MEDIUM unmet; no fallback to a different window

MEDIUM.drift: true prohibited; unknown allowed with explicit warning

sampleConfidence.confidenceMeaning: Sampling-precision policy for stored estimates, NOT calibrated probability, symbol-specific temporal reliability, or trading readiness
sampleConfidence.episodes: Use stored event-bearing session counts for conditional traits only; individual intraday episode counts unavailable. For unconditional rates also derive positive sessions as raw rate*nSessions, explicitly NOT episodes.
sampleConfidence.fixedSafety: All existing nine Safety flags false; historical research only; no production/PIT/OOS claim
sampleConfidence.integration: Code union and intersection reported. Dedupe same trait across lanes for count; keep both records/provenance. Any simultaneous handoff requires matched computed_through, both independently valid, same definition/units, fresh Reader. Different lane endpoints imply no certified joint current profile. Never carry old daily values silently forward.
sampleConfidence.peerDifferentiation: abs(posterior-peer_prediction)>1.96*posterior_sd, in transformed units; conditional on fitted prior, exploratory/unadjusted, not a symbol-level significance certificate
sampleConfidence.priorExposure: Fixed Gate results and previous anatomy have been viewed. This is a post-hoc descriptive coverage diagnostic, never a new confirmatory result.
sampleConfidence.referenceScale: Population SD (ddof=0) of frozen A peer-relative values for the same lane/trait; zero or absent => normalized uncertainty unknown
sampleConfidence.representatives: Primary60 intraday PDH: lowest code in each HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/INSUFFICIENT category present, then lowest code at min/median/max usable H+M count; remove duplicates. No return/outcome-based selection.
sampleConfidence.signStability: Report saved global incremental/reverse direction; per-symbol A/B raw-centered sign agreement descriptive only because B peer predictions are not saved. Window residual signs compare overlapping snapshots only, not independent stability.
sampleConfidence.sparseDispatch: Dry contract only. Only global USABLE plus HIGH/MEDIUM may enter candidate payload; WATCH excluded regardless of confidence. Current interface-ready=false globally. No Entry/EXIT trials.
sampleConfidence.stop: After tests, full regression, deterministic regeneration, CI, Evidence, visualization and handoff
sampleConfidence.stratification: Reconstruct A mean logVa/logS/logPrice/coverage from saved peer prediction linear identities, standardized coefficients, mu and SD. Require >=6 equations, identifiable coordinates, condition<=1e8, held-out equation residual<=1e-8*(1+abs(prediction)); unavailable coordinates UNKNOWN. Verify logVa against saved trading_value transformedA when available. A-only tertiles pooled per lane, ties deterministic; strata are historical A, not current snapshot covariates. No raw payloads opened.
sampleConfidence.targets: All 9 lane-USABLE verdicts and all 23 calibration-only lane-WATCH verdicts; no promotion or Gate changes

schedule.method: Earliest calendar-only 60-position source with30 potentially valid sessions; earliest20-potentially-valid target after embargo5. Mapping completes calibration before both validation origins. Second validation target begins after first target ends; source origin is latest eligible past origin with embargo5. No scoring/window alternatives.
schedule.minimality: Calendar support witness with earliest first/second origins; not a global optimum over unspecified designs. Source windows can include earlier observed portions of previous validation target, but targets are disjoint and mapping is fixed at calibration completion. Independence means disjoint target dates, not iid statistical independence.

sourceWindow: 60 exchange calendar positions ending at fixed origin; excluded slots NaN, no compressed time; unchanged history reset/scale warm-up
targetWindow: Frozen calendar ranges shown above, containing26/26/20 authorized sessions and20 calendar-potential eligible observations. Changes target span, not minimum-N. All actual20 eligible-day constraints retained; insufficient cells remain insufficient.

temporalPolicy.meaning: Separate descriptive Development temporal screen; NOT confirmatory symbol p-values. All conditions conjunctive, unknown fails closed; source H/M and target sample minima required per fold; no threshold tuning. Sign uses frozen-source-peer residuals. Magnitude/calibration/bias normalized by source residual SD. Drift and recent/long snapshots reported separately; current drift true excludes dispatch.
